name: VictoriaMetrics
description: VictoriaMetrics reads over its Prometheus-compatible HTTP API: instant and range PromQL queries, label and label-value listing, and TSDB series/cardinality status. Read-only; no data ingestion or admin endpoint is wired here. It is unauthenticated by default (base_url is the only credential); put it behind a reverse proxy for exposure beyond a trusted LAN.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Evaluate a PromQL expression at a single instant and return the matching series with their values (e.g. 'up', 'vm_app_version')

time.description: Optional evaluation timestamp, RFC3339 or a Unix timestamp (defaults to now)

tools.name: query_range
tools.description: Evaluate a PromQL expression over a time range at a fixed step and return each series as a list of timestamped samples

start.description: Range start, RFC3339 or a Unix timestamp

end.description: Range end, RFC3339 or a Unix timestamp

step.description: Resolution step, a duration such as 60s or 5m, or a number of seconds

tools.name: labels
tools.description: List every label name known to this instance

tools.name: label_values
tools.description: List the values a label takes across the series in this instance (use __name__ to list every metric name)

label.description: Label name to list values for, e.g. __name__, job or instance

tools.name: tsdb_status
tools.description: Get TSDB cardinality status: total series, total label/value pairs and top series counts by metric name

needs_review: AUTH IS none BY DESIGN: VictoriaMetrics ships with no authentication on its HTTP API by default, so base_url is the only credential and auth.type is 'none'. An internet-exposed instance must sit behind a reverse proxy; that is a deployment concern, not a spec one.
READ-ONLY: all five tools are GET, write:false. VictoriaMetrics's write surface (/api/v1/import, /api/v1/write, admin/snapshot endpoints) is not modelled here.
query probes vm_app_version, a metric VictoriaMetrics exposes about itself from boot, so the live proof gets a non-empty result even on a just-started instance.

query_range probes a FIXED 2020 five-minute window, before any ephemeral instance existed; the honest expected result is a 200 with an empty result array, proving routing and the envelope keys, not the sample shape.
PICK SHAPES follow the Prometheus-compatible envelope: metric/value/values are kept as the raw objects the API returns, since Connector Spec v1 has no computed fields to flatten them.

LIVE-PROOF CONTRACT: query pins vm_app_version; query_range pins the fixed 2020 window; label_values pins __name__; labels and tsdb_status take no input, _probe {}. Proven against docker victoriametrics/victoria-metrics:v1.102.1, then destroyed.
